title: WorldGen - Local NPC Models
footer: Actual game UI - local models - warmed menu samples, not world FPS

pages.title: Four models, one AI tab
pages.subtitle: Switch local NPC models without rebuilding the game or duplicating their weights.

images.caption: Actual AI settings: all four installed models, resource presets and CUDA/Vulkan selection.

blocks.text: Open Settings > AI. Choose a model and a hardware preset, then Apply & restart AI. Use Load model, followed by Test saved settings. Repeat the short test after loading. The same selection is used by NPC conversations and event-driven thoughts.

rows: Expert model, with adjustable CPU/GPU split

blocks.text: The three additional models remain in D:\WorldGenModels\NpcAI. D is a mechanical drive, so initial loading can be slow. Keep one shared copy; after comparison, delete losing candidates and consider moving the winner to C. Your existing saved AI profile was preserved.

pages.title: Give AI the resources
pages.subtitle: Ordinary presets remain available. Max speed deliberately trades rendering smoothness for inference.

images.caption: Actual GPT-OSS status. Layer offload includes GPU attention; 12 expert layers intentionally remain on CPU.

blocks.text: One repeated short menu prompt per model/backend; 298-359 input tokens with model-specific tokenization. Brief structured replies, 2,048 context, Ryzen 5700X / RTX 4060 8 GB / 32 GB RAM. These samples establish usable output, not an intelligence ranking or gameplay FPS guarantee. A full scene can leave less GPU memory available.

rows: High CPU priority, 8 generation / 16 prompt threads on this PC, active polling, and 15 FPS while AI works. Normal FPS and VSync return afterward.
GPU preset: 1,024 MiB. Max speed: 512 MiB. Manual 0 remains available; memory spill can make it slower.
GPT-OSS starts with 12 expert layers on CPU, with explicit RAM loading. Both controls remain adjustable.
Compare CUDA and Vulkan. More workers or more offload do not always produce a faster reply.

blocks.text: Verified: 70 settings checks across all eight model/backend combinations, plus 18 in-world NPC checks with Qwen3.5-9B. Current presentation uses complete validated replies; streamed speech text remains a separate next step. Switching and unloading release the single model host.
